title: One JSON file per record instead of one tasks.json
context: Several people and agents edit the same repo on different branches. A single file conflicts on almost every merge.
decision: Each record is its own file at .repostate/<scope>/<type>/<id>.json, with random ids so two branches never create the same id.
consequences: Merges only conflict when two people edit the same record. Listing needs a folder scan, which is fast at repo scale.
alternatives: JSONL with a custom merge driver
after: one JSON file per record, written by the CLI
author: noreply@anthropic.com
